entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... um... I think I need to return something? I'm not sure if I can.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name please?

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here with a recent purchase of the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Now, to make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I... I don't think it's broken. It's just... it's a lot. I'm a bit overwhelmed with all the features and I don't think it's for me. I tried to look at the website but it was all confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help you with this. It's completely understandable. Looking at your order, it was delivered 17 days ago. Let me just check the details for you.
Okay... I was worried it might be an issue.

I just need to be thorough. For wearable devices, our return **policy** can be quite specific. Due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** concerns with items worn on the skin, once a certain period passes, it's often **too late** to accept them back. Let me just pull up the exact terms for your VeloBand.

Okay, thanks for holding, Sarah. I've double-checked, and good news! Your VeloBand GPS Tracker is covered by our 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much!

You are very welcome. I'm glad we could sort this out. I've just initiated the return and emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. Please place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
That's perfect. That's so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can do for you today at VeloFit?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Have a great day!
